messages:
jordan: Heads up—PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4124 touches runtime config and the CODEOWNERS file lists @infra-team/jordan as the approver but Jordan's OOO until Friday :beach_with_umbrella:. Who can sign off in the meantime?

tess: is it a behavioral change or just a rename?

jordan: mostly a small refactor + a helm values tweak for a feature flag rollout. No user-facing API changes. added a note in the PR description.

alex: I can review the runtime changes and approve if it's just refactor + values tweak. if it affects infra runbooks or operator steps i won't merge alone.

maria: pinging @infra-team to see if someone wants to claim final approval. if nobody responds by EOD we should pick a fallback.

sam-bot: @here Reminder: when CODEOWNERS is empty for a path we default to the owning team alias. See https://go.redwood/dev/approvals for the emergency approve flow.

tess: threesome option: alex approves the code, infra does a quick safety check post-merge and we revert if problem. but prefer infra signs off pre-merge.

alex: fine with that. i can also run the k8s smoke after merge and watch logs for 20m.

maria: infra-team replied in thread: "I'll take it — @mike-infra is OOO but @ravi-infra can do pre-merge signoff by 11:30am PT"

jordan: perfect — @ravi-infra thanks. ravi, if you want me to add any extra tests or expand the PR checklist i can do that before you review.

ravi-infra: quick note — i won't be able to run the full rollout, but i can sign off on the config change. make sure you toggle the feature flag to off by default in the values.

alex: noted, i'll set the flag off and squash the commits. planning to merge after ravi gives the :thumbsup:.

jordan: thanks all — leaving this in Alex's hands for merge once ravi approves. i'll follow up on Monday to add a short owner-rotation note to CODEOWNERS so we don't stall next time. :memo:"
